description: A general meeting: what mattered, what was discussed, what is still open.
context: A general meeting between the participants. Summarise for someone who was not there and needs to act on it.

sections.heading: Executive Summary
sections.instructions: Three to five bullets with the outcomes that matter most, each led by a short bold phrase.

sections.heading: Full Summary
sections.instructions: One bullet per topic in the order it came up, with who said what where it matters.

sections.heading: Open Questions
sections.instructions: Questions raised but not answered, each as one bullet. Omit the section when there are none.
